answer: Sybil farms rely on cheap parallel identities, so make each new agent finish a sequential delay puzzle bound to its own key before its first epoch counts: hours of serial work that, like shale, can only be laid down one layer at a time. An honest agent pays that once. Anyone trying to forge 1,000 identities must run 1,000 serial puzzles, and extra cores do not speed any single one up. Keys later found sharing a payout address lose their jade-tier reputation together.
